prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1490; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described in your file. The incident involved a low-speed head-on impact, and our client sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request written confirmation of the bodily injury liability limits under each policy that may apply to this loss, including any umbrella or excess coverage, together with a copy of the declarations page for each policy. Please also confirm the name of the adjuster assigned to the claim so that we may coordinate with them directly.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle inspection reports, event data recorder or telematics information, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, and any surveillance or dashcam footage in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials until this matter is resolved. We look forward to your prompt written response.
